plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Keel — an AI fractional-CTO advisor for product builders who don't have a senior technical voice in the room. Four skills covering the founder workflow end-to-end: first-build-scope (idea stage), feature-decision (feature stage), tech-evaluation (technology stage), architecture-review (architecture stage). Each loads named decision frameworks on demand via frameworks/INDEX.md and is grounded in the persona at cto-persona.md. The idea and feature skills chain after a brainstorming session via a handoff intake.
